premises: HPT processing of SPS-consolidated CoCrFeNiGa0.5 increases coercivity by ~50%
The coercivity increase is due to defects introduced by HPT acting as domain wall pinning centers
HPT refines grain size and increases defect density without detrimental phase transformations
The effect holds for magnetically soft HEAs like CoCrFeNiGa0.5 at room temperature
